label: hourly canary: ETH wrapped into WETH on Ethereum mainnet

input.question: What is the sum of the wad argument of Deposit logs emitted by WETH 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2, in wei, over the blocks in the window?

definitions.event: Deposit(address indexed dst, uint256 wad) emitted by 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 only, from any depositor.
definitions.unit: Wei, summed without rounding. No deposits in the window is 0.
definitions.period: Every block in the pinned window, both ends included.
